feature: Add Mobile Navigation Menu to Landing Page
workflow_rationale: Single file UI enhancement following existing patterns. No database, API, or multi-service changes. Existing dashboard mobile menu provides clear implementation pattern to follow.

phases.name: Mobile Navigation Menu Implementation
phases.description: Add hamburger menu button and slide-out navigation menu for mobile devices on the landing page

subtasks.description: Convert Navigation component to client component and add menu state
implementation_notes: Add 'use client' directive at top of Navigation function
Import useState from 'react'
Add state: const [mobileMenuOpen, setMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false)
This follows the pattern from dashboard-layout-client.tsx line 85
subtasks.notes: Successfully converted Navigation component to client component with menu state. Created new app/navigation.tsx with 'use client' directive, useState hook for mobileMenuOpen state, and hamburger menu toggle button. Updated app/page.tsx to import the new component. Implementation follows patterns from dashboard-layout-client.tsx.

subtasks.description: Add hamburger menu button for mobile
implementation_notes: Replace the current 'Başla' button (lines 372-378) with hamburger button
Copy hamburger icon SVG from components/dashboard/header.tsx lines 67-69
Button should have: md:hidden className, onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(true)}
Keep the 'Başla' button but move it inside the mobile menu

checks: Hamburger icon visible on mobile (< 768px width)
Hamburger icon hidden on desktop (>= 768px width)
Clicking hamburger button opens mobile menu

subtasks.notes: Hamburger menu button is already fully implemented in app/navigation.tsx (lines 65-82). The button is visible on mobile (< 768px) with md:hidden class, includes proper onClick handler to toggle mobileMenuOpen state, has accessible aria-label and aria-expanded attributes, and displays hamburger icon when closed and X icon when open. Implementation follows the pattern from components/dashboard/header.tsx. Mobile menu panel (lines 86-120) opens when button is clicked.

implementation_notes: Add backdrop overlay when menu is open (similar to sidebar.tsx lines 176-183)
Backdrop: fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/50 lg:hidden, onClick closes menu
Add slide-out menu panel: fixed top-0 right-0 h-full w-64 bg-white
Use transform classes: mobileMenuOpen ? 'translate-x-0' : 'translate-x-full'
Add transition-transform duration-200 ease-in-out for smooth animation
Include close button (X icon) in top-right corner
List all navigation links vertically: Özellikler, Fiyatlandırma, Giriş Yap, Ücretsiz Dene
Style links with proper spacing and hover states
Menu should close when clicking a link or backdrop

checks: Mobile menu slides in from right when hamburger clicked
All navigation links are visible and clickable
Clicking a link navigates and closes menu
Menu is hidden on desktop (>= 768px width)

subtasks.notes: Implemented slide-out mobile navigation menu with backdrop, close button, and smooth animations. Menu slides in from right on mobile, hidden on desktop. All links close menu when clicked. Follows sidebar.tsx pattern for consistency.

implementation_notes: Test at multiple viewport sizes: 375px (mobile), 768px (tablet), 1024px (desktop)
Verify desktop navigation still works unchanged
Check that mobile menu doesn't interfere with desktop layout
Verify keyboard accessibility (ESC key should close menu)
Test dark mode if applicable

instructions: Resize to mobile width (< 768px) - verify hamburger visible
Click hamburger - verify menu slides in from right
Click each link - verify navigation works and menu closes
Press ESC key - verify menu closes
Resize to desktop width (>= 768px) - verify desktop nav unchanged

subtasks.notes: Added ESC key accessibility handler using useEffect hook. Mobile navigation menu implementation is complete with all features: hamburger button toggle, slide-out menu animation, backdrop overlay, close button, link navigation with menu closure, and ESC key support. All accessibility requirements met with proper aria-labels and keyboard support. Ready for manual testing verification.

acceptance_criteria: Mobile users can access all navigation links via hamburger menu
Menu closes when clicking links, backdrop, or close button
Responsive behavior works across different viewport sizes

verification_steps.name: Visual Verification
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Mobile menu works correctly at all viewport sizes

verification_strategy.reasoning: Low risk UI-only change with existing patterns. No tests required as this is a visual enhancement. Manual verification is sufficient.

unit_tests.rationale: Simple UI component with no business logic to test

integration_tests.rationale: No API or database integration involved

e2e_tests.rationale: Visual UI enhancement doesn't require E2E tests

checks: Menu closes on link click, backdrop click, and close button
